Root cause: constant folding executed custom filters and tests during compilation, but only suppressed `TypeError` and `ValueError`. Other exceptions escaped from `from_string`.

Changed `_FilterTestCommon.as_const` to convert all regular exceptions from constant filter/test evaluation into `Impossible`, so compilation leaves those expressions for runtime evaluation. Built-in invalid literal arguments remain unoptimized, while live-branch custom filters still raise during rendering. Tests pass.

final_text:
Root cause: constant folding executed custom filters and tests during compilation, but only suppressed `TypeError` and `ValueError`. Other exceptions escaped from `from_string`.

Changed `_FilterTestCommon.as_const` to convert all regular exceptions from constant filter/test evaluation into `Impossible`, so compilation leaves those expressions for runtime evaluation. Built-in invalid literal arguments remain unoptimized, while live-branch custom filters still raise during rendering. Tests pass.
